sources.role: core installation, BIOS, saves and state documentation

paths.path: RetroArch's retroarch.cfg and core options; melonDS DS has no native config file.
paths.naming: Libretro frontend configuration, not a standalone melonDS DS profile.

paths.path: RetroArch port 1 RETRO_DEVICE_JOYPAD plus pointer/mouse/analog APIs; host mapping is RetroArch-owned.
paths.naming: Nintendo DS core port; no standalone SDL device selector.

paths.path: RetroArch save directory, normally <content basename>.srm/.sav according to core info and subsystem metadata.
paths.naming: Frontend-owned content-basename naming; the pinned core metadata/source exposes .srm/.sav save data.

paths.path: RetroArch serialized state directory using frontend-generated .state naming; homebrew and DSi limitations apply.
paths.naming: Core advertises savestate support; README says homebrew savestates are unsupported/limited and DSi mode does not support them.

paths.path: RetroArch system/melonDS DS/: bios7.bin, bios9.bin, dsi_bios7.bin, dsi_bios9.bin; firmware/NAND filenames are core-option selected. Built-in replacements cover many games.
paths.naming: DS ARM7/ARM9 BIOS names are fixed; firmware and NAND are user-selected images.

paths.path: <RetroArch application directory>\retroarch.cfg (fallback %APPDATA%\retroarch.cfg); melonDS DS has no native config file.
paths.naming: RetroArch key = value syntax plus melonDS DS core options; no standalone profile.

paths.path: RetroArch per-port input_playerN_* bindings; core sees port 1 RETRO_DEVICE_JOYPAD plus pointer/mouse/analog APIs.
paths.naming: Host mapping is RetroArch-owned; core input APIs declared in info/input sources.

paths.path: <RetroArch application directory>\saves\ (or explicit savefile_directory); <content basename>.srm/.sav per core info.
paths.naming: Frontend save directory with core-declared SRAM extensions.

paths.path: <RetroArch application directory>\states\ (or explicit savestate_directory); frontend .state naming.
paths.naming: Serialized states via frontend; homebrew/DSi limitations apply.

paths.path: <RetroArch application directory>\system\melonDS DS\: bios7.bin, bios9.bin, dsi_bios7.bin, dsi_bios9.bin; firmware/NAND names are core-option selected.
paths.naming: System dir plus melonDS DS/ subdirectory; filenames core-option selected.

paths.path: No external cryptographic key material required
paths.naming: No encrypted firmware or key files.

paths.path: ~/Library/Application Support/RetroArch/config/retroarch.cfg (portable installs may be beside the app); melonDS DS has no native config file.
paths.naming: RetroArch key = value syntax plus melonDS DS core options; no standalone profile.

paths.path: RetroArch per-port input_playerN_* bindings; core sees port 1 RETRO_DEVICE_JOYPAD plus pointer/mouse/analog APIs.
paths.naming: Host mapping is RetroArch-owned; core input APIs declared in info/input sources.

paths.path: ~/Documents/RetroArch/saves/ (portable installs may be beside the app); <content basename>.srm/.sav per core info.
paths.naming: Frontend save directory with core-declared SRAM extensions.

paths.path: ~/Documents/RetroArch/states/ (portable installs may be beside the app); frontend .state naming.
paths.naming: Serialized states via frontend; homebrew/DSi limitations apply.

paths.path: ~/Documents/RetroArch/system/melonDS DS/: bios7.bin, bios9.bin, dsi_bios7.bin, dsi_bios9.bin; firmware/NAND names are core-option selected.
paths.naming: System dir plus melonDS DS/ subdirectory; filenames core-option selected.

paths.path: No external cryptographic key material required
paths.naming: No encrypted firmware or key files.

linux-flatpak.reason: melonDS DS is a libretro core; Flatpak behavior is determined by the chosen RetroArch package and its sandbox paths, so no standalone host contract is captured.

notes: No native standalone adapter is implemented. Use the existing RetroArch/libretro controller path; runtime core/frontend activation remains unverified.
